Game Overview

In Fit Cats, the core idea is straightforward: guide your adorable feline friends into the right boxes in this quirky puzzle game. Combine cats of the same size to create bigger ones while skillfully chasing mischievous mice for strategic boosts. Test your planning skills and aim to unlock an entire world of charming, collectable kittens.
